title: Counting functions bad at a fixed coordinate
statement:
Let $\iota$ be a finite index type with decidable equality, let $(\beta_j)_{j \in \iota}$ be a family of finite types, and fix a coordinate $i \in \iota$. Let $\mathrm{Bad}$ be a decidable predicate on $\beta_i$, and let $C$ be a natural number such that
\[
\abs{\{\, b \in \beta_i : \mathrm{Bad}(b) \,\}} \cdot C \;\le\; \abs{\beta_i}.
\]
Then the number of dependent functions $f \in \prod_{j \in \iota} \beta_j$ whose value at $i$ is bad satisfies
\[
\abs{\{\, f \in \textstyle\prod_{j \in \iota} \beta_j : \mathrm{Bad}(f(i)) \,\}} \cdot C \;\le\; \abs{\textstyle\prod_{j \in \iota} \beta_j}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: Bad a decidable predicate on β_i
replaced:
Fix a coordinate $i$ and a decidable predicate $\mathrm{Bad}$ on $\beta_i$, and suppose
$\abs{\{b : \mathrm{Bad}(b)\}} \cdot C \le \abs{\beta_i}$.  Then the number of dependent functions
$f$ with $\mathrm{Bad}(f_i)$ satisfies
\[
\abs{\{f : \mathrm{Bad}(f_i)\}} \cdot C \;\le\; \abs{(j : \iota) \to \beta_j}.
\]
